paragraphs: Rabbi Dosa: in the Mishnah, Shabbat 20:4; Eruvin, “נ” [unresolved], 3:9; Chullin 1:7; Bekhorot 7:2; Tohorot 8:8. In the city of Paras are buried Rav Chasdai, Rabbi Akiva—this is not the one among the ten martyrs; see Rabbi Akiva—and Rabbi Dosa (G.A.Y.).
